description: This Java source file defines the UpdateUserCommandHandler class responsible for handling user update commands within the Fineract system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and uses the AppUserWritePlatformService to execute user update operations.

classes.name: UpdateUserCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that processes update commands for user entities. It handles command processing, transaction management, and delegates the update operation to the AppUserWritePlatformService.

methods.name: UpdateUserCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the AppUserWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to update a user by extracting the user ID from the command and invoking the updateUser method on the service.
